Metadata.description: Receive your parcels at a trusted neighbor or local shop in Portugal.

Home.title: Never miss a delivery again
Home.lead: Have parcels delivered to a verified neighbor or local shop near you, then collect them when it suits you with a one-time pickup code.

steps.title: How it works
steps.find: Find a host near you on the map
steps.reserve: Reserve and use their address at checkout

demo.title: Explore the demo
demo.body: This is a portfolio project with mock data. Jump straight in with a ready-made account:
demo.customerHint: Find hosts and reserve a pickup
demo.hostHint: Accept parcels and hand them over

Home.disclaimer: Vizinho has no integration with merchants or carriers. Whether a delivery can be made to a host's address depends on each merchant and carrier.

customer.subtitle: Track your parcels and find hosts nearby.
customer.emptyBody: Find a verified host near you and reserve a pickup spot before you order.
customer.howBody: Reserve a host, use the address they share at checkout, then collect your parcel with a one-time code.

host.subtitle: Manage requests, parcels in storage and your availability.
host.capacityValue: Up to {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} at a time
host.openingSlotsValue: {count, plural, =0 {Not set} one {# weekly slot} other {# weekly slots}}
host.noListing: You don't have a host listing yet.

ComingSoon.body: This part of Vizinho is on the roadmap.

customer.findHost: A full-screen map that uses your location to show approved hosts nearby, with their hours and rules.
customer.parcels: Your reservations and parcels, with live status updates and one-time pickup codes.
customer.help: Answers to common questions and a way to report a problem with a parcel.

host.requests: Accept or decline reservation requests before your address is shared.
host.storage: Check parcels in with a photo, see what's stored and hand parcels over with a pickup code.
host.schedule: Set your weekly opening hours, time off and how many parcels you can hold.

admin.hosts: Review and approve host applications, and suspend hosts if needed.
admin.reservations: Every reservation's lifecycle and custody trail.
admin.incidents: Investigate damaged, missing or unknown parcels and resolve disputes.
admin.audit: An append-only log of every privileged action.
